adjudication.rationale: In Office365CalendarService the token parsing now routes through parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema). When APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED + CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT are set, parseRefreshTokenResponse uses minimumTokenResponseSchema, which is not a passthrough/catchall schema and (as written) does not clearly preserve fields like `expires_in`/`expiry_date` from the real token response—unknown keys would be stripped. Since the updated credential is built by merging `tokenResponse.data` into the existing stored credentials, stripped expiry fields can leave the old (possibly expired) expiry values in place, causing repeated refresh attempts. This is a correctness issue introduced by the diff; the exact “N×M storm” magnitude isn’t directly verifiable here, but the root condition (expiry not updated in sync mode due to the minimum schema) is grounded in the diff.
